thread:
Nora Fields: Heads up — Sunrise reported a large billing jump on 2026-05-14 invoice. Customer says they did not increase usage; ledger shows ~11,200 embeds billed for 02:10-02:30 UTC but canonical shows 5,600. That looks like a 2x overcount. Can infra investigate whether ack duplication occurred?

BillingBot: [alert] meter-forwarder shard-3 duplicated publish batch detected 2026-05-14T02:15:44Z -> duplicated-topic-duplicates=2. Incident id: MF-9921.

Diego Alvarez: Quick triage: ingest proxy received a burst of client retries at 02:14 due to a transient timeout. A bug in the ack-forwarder caused the same ack batch to be published twice to billing-acks when the retry loop retried an already-sent batch. We're seeing duplicate idempotency keys for those messages.

Sofia Park: Can we correct ledger by deduplicating those messages post-hoc? What's the safe path for accounting/audit?

Diego Alvarez: We can run a dedupe job that reads billing-acks for that window, drops duplicates by idempotency_key, and emits a corrected recount. That produces a clear audit trail and keeps invoices consistent. Work: ~2 hours including QA. Risk: must ensure downstream reports use corrected ledger snapshot.

Rahul Menon: Finance preference is to correct system-of-record rather than issue credits. As long as we produce an auditable manifest showing records removed and their checksums, legal and auditors are comfortable.

Nora Fields: Please provide an estimate of dollar impact so I can notify the customer proactively.

Diego Alvarez: Impact: overcount = 11,200 - 5,600 = 5,600 duplicate embeds. Pricing tier for Sunrise is $0.11/embed -> delta = $616.00.

Sofia Park: Action plan: (1) run dedupe-and-recount job for 02:05-02:35 UTC, (2) produce manifest: job_id=dedupe-mf-9921, removed=5600, sha256=6e2f9b1c... , (3) update ledger snapshot and attach manifest to invoice notes. ETA 2.5 hours.

BillingBot: [info] ticket FIN-8019 created: "Sunrise duplicate metering spike - dedupe backfill" assigned @Diego Alvarez.

Nora Fields: OK proceed. Rahul/Finance will hold any dispute until dedupe finished. I'll prep a brief customer note: "We've found duplicated billing events in a short window and will correct your invoice. No action required."

Diego Alvarez: Dedupe job complete at 2026-05-14T05:02:11Z. Artifact: job_id=dedupe-mf-9921, removed=5600, sha256=6e2f9b1c4a8d... Link: s3://redwood-telemetry/dedupe/dedupe-mf-9921/manifest.json

Sofia Park: Post-dedupe ledger recount matches canonical. Uploaded recount.csv and manifest to s3://redwood-finance/reconciliations/2026-05-14/sunrise-dedupe-recount.csv

Rahul Menon: Confirming finance will adjust the invoice downward by $616.00 and attach dedupe manifest to billing notes. Marking FIN-8019 -> awaiting customer ack.

Nora Fields: Sending customer message now. Closing thread after Sunrise confirms. :white_check_mark:
